liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Shakedown Street is full of energy, while Wharf Rat is described as amazing [21]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song jams far out, cited as one of the best versions of all time [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-09-12.142836.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 200 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1981-09-12.158148.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 198 min [3]
- **gd1981-09-12.nak700.anon-poris-severson.LMPP.95391.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 197 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [6]
- **gd1981-09-12.nak700.martin.warner.23729.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 199 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [9]
- **gd81-09-12.aud.wise.25317.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 190 min; rated 4.46/5 by 13 [15]. Said about its sound: The audience recording smokes, capturing the pure excitement of the crowd [24]
- **gd81-09-12.wise.munder.7091.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 188 min; rated 4.38/5 by 16 [16]. Said about its sound: The recording is wonderful, even capturing Phil rocking the room [22]

## Around the show

- Bob urged the crowd to fetch Phil, leading to a double encore [19]
- The Greek Theatre provided great acoustics, and the band seemed to love playing there [22]
- Bay Area audiences were laid back, letting the band play without anxiety [25]
- These were believed to be the first Greek shows since the 1960s [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-09-12.142836.fob.senn421.wise.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UD-XLII); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes… [1]. Also: Jim Wise recorded the show and provided a fresh transcription of his FOB audience master [1]
- **gd1981-09-12.158148.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [3]
- **gd1981-09-12.nak700.anon-poris-severson.LMPP.95391.flac16**: taped by anonymous taper, Jamie Poris, Mark Severson; transferred by Brian Green and Evan K.; source: 3 Nakamichi 700's (l & R-Cross Cardiod, 6db Bass EQ, 75 Deg angle, center-omni straight at stage, 40 deg up) 40 feet from stage, dead center > 3 mic mixer(made… [6]. Also: An anonymous taper spent the weekend waiting in line to find the best sound spot [6]
- **gd1981-09-12.nak700.martin.warner.23729.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Steven Martin; transferred by (EAC > SHN by Jack Warner); source: modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M > MAC (Maxell metal tape) [9]. Also: Jim Wise's Sennheiser 421s were recorded to Sony TC-D5 for the encore patch [9]
- **gd81-09-12.aud.wise.25317.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [15]
- **gd81-09-12.wise.munder.7091.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [16]. Also: Jim Wise recorded the show, filling a void for missing soundboards of this Greek run [18]
